# Resource: stripe_product_catalog_trial_offer

A trial period a price offers before it transitions to another price. `terraform destroy` archives the trial offer, because Stripe cannot delete one.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "stripe_product" "gold" {
  name = "Gold plan"
}

resource "stripe_price" "trial" {
  product     = stripe_product.gold.id
  currency    = "usd"
  unit_amount = 100

  recurring = {
    interval = "month"
  }
}

resource "stripe_price" "full" {
  product     = stripe_product.gold.id
  currency    = "usd"
  unit_amount = 1000

  recurring = {
    interval = "month"
  }
}

resource "stripe_product_catalog_trial_offer" "first_month" {
  price    = stripe_price.trial.id
  nickname = "First month"

  duration = {
    type     = "relative"
    relative = { iterations = 1 }
  }

  end_behavior = {
    transition = { price = stripe_price.full.id }
  }
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are required:

* `duration` - (Required) Duration of one service period of the trial. Changing it replaces the resource. See [`duration`](#duration) below.
* `end_behavior` - (Required) Define behavior that occurs at the end of the trial. Changing it replaces the resource. See [`end_behavior`](#end_behavior) below.
* `price` - (Required) Price configuration during the trial period (amount, billing scheme, etc). Changing it replaces the resource.

The following arguments are optional:

* `active` - (Optional) Whether the trial offer can be used for new subscriptions. Defaults to true.
* `nickname` - (Optional) A brief description of the trial offer, hidden from customers. Changing it replaces the resource.

<a id="duration"></a>
### `duration`

The `duration` attribute supports:

* `relative` - (Optional) See [`duration.relative`](#duration.relative) below.
* `type` - (Required) The type of trial offer duration. Possible values: `relative`.

<a id="duration.relative"></a>
### `duration.relative`

The `duration.relative` attribute supports:

* `iterations` - (Required) The number of iterations of the price's interval for this trial offer.

<a id="end_behavior"></a>
### `end_behavior`

The `end_behavior` attribute supports:

* `transition` - (Required) See [`end_behavior.transition`](#end_behavior.transition) below.
* `type` - (Read-Only) The type of behavior when the trial offer ends. Possible values: `transition`.

<a id="end_behavior.transition"></a>
### `end_behavior.transition`

The `end_behavior.transition` attribute supports:

* `price` - (Required) The new price to use at the end of the trial offer period.

## Attribute Reference

This resource exports the following attributes in addition to the arguments above:

* `id` - Unique identifier for the object.
* `livemode` - If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.

## Timeouts

[Configuration options](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/syntax#operation-timeouts) are set with the `timeouts` attribute, for example `timeouts = { create = "5m" }`:

* `create` - (Default `20m`)
* `delete` - (Default `20m`)
* `update` - (Default `20m`)

## Import

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, and in OpenTofu, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import a product catalog trial offer using its ID. For example:

```terraform
import {
  to = stripe_product_catalog_trial_offer.first_month
  id = "to_123"
}
```

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, and in OpenTofu v1.12.0 and later, the `import` block can use the `identity` attribute instead. For example:

```terraform
import {
  to = stripe_product_catalog_trial_offer.first_month
  identity = {
    id = "to_123"
  }
}
```

### Identity Schema

#### Required

* `id` (String) The Stripe ID of the product catalog trial offer.

Using `terraform import`, import a product catalog trial offer using its ID. For example:

```console
% terraform import stripe_product_catalog_trial_offer.first_month to_123
```
